svg.title: Hand-chain block — Handkeðjutalía
svg.desc: A round hoisting body has a long loop of hand chain to one side and a separate load line and hook below.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-hand-chain-block","label_en":"Hand-chain block","label_is":"Handkeðjutalía","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["rigging","hoist"],"description":"A round hoisting body has a long loop of hand chain to one side and a separate load line and hook below.","design_note":"Separate operating-chain loop and load hook distinguish a chain block from the lever-operated hoist.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
